name: Job Interview
guidelines: Prioritize structured tailoring and restrained color discipline;Ensure grooming is pristine, hair disciplined, and collar crisp;Avoid loud logos, excessive jewelry, and casual sneakers

name: Modern Office / Workplace
guidelines: Balance comfort and professional authority;Knit polos, tailored trousers, clean derbies or minimal leather sneakers;Neutral and earth tones communicate competence and calm

name: Everyday Casual / Weekend
guidelines: Effortless silhouettes with high breathability and walkability;Boxy cut tees, relaxed chinos, unbuttoned lightweight overshirts

name: Fine Dining / Dinner Party
guidelines: Sophisticated layering, structured outerwear, and immaculate footwear;Drape and fabric texture are paramount under warm ambient restaurant lighting

name: Evening Date
guidelines: Focus on tactile textures (merino, suede, brushed cotton) that invite closeness;Silhouette should look intentional and well-proportioned without looking over-stiff;Elevate through dark palette anchoring (black, charcoal, deep navy, rich brown)

name: Night Out / Lounge / Club
guidelines: Embrace edge, contrast, and darker moody tones;Strong silhouette: cropped leather jackets, relaxed wide trousers, or statement boots;Jewelry and subtle accessories can take center stage

name: Social Gathering / House Party
guidelines: Expressive styling with conversation-starter silhouettes or textures;High mobility and effortless self-assured presence

name: University / College Campus
guidelines: Comfort-driven layered casual with strong proportions;Heavyweight hoodies under work jackets, relaxed denim, timeless sneakers

name: Wedding Guest
guidelines: Honor ceremonial formality without overshadowing the hosts;Never wear all-white; choose rich navy, charcoal, or refined earthy linen suits;Pair with polished oxfords or dress loafers

name: Cultural / Traditional Ceremony
guidelines: Honors heritage textiles, bespoke regional drapery, and ceremonial reverence;Welcomes sherwani, kurta, bandhgala, barong tagalog, hanbok, kimono, bespoke linen tunics, and cultural formalwear;System does NOT default automatically to Western business suiting when cultural context is selected

name: Airport / Travel Transit
guidelines: Wrinkle-resistant fabrics, functional layers for temperature shifts;Easy slip-on footwear and ergonomic relaxed trousers

name: Custom Curated Event
guidelines: Adaptable contextual configuration based on custom user specification
